title: Paper Record — PhD Thesis Butler v4.0
description: Metadata record for a single source document (dissertation or abstract) in the corpus.

id.description: Unique paper ID following convention: paper_{incremental_id}

title_ru.description: Russian title of the dissertation or abstract (derived from source metadata). May be 'unknown' if unavailable.
examples: Методы оптимизации управления сложными техническими системами

discipline.description: Academic discipline extracted from _discipline field of source entries.

cluster.description: Cluster derived from directory path (NOT from _layer field due to known bug).

page_count.description: Page count of the source document. 0 if unknown.

DIS_categories_covered.description: List of DIS categories present in this paper.

template_count_per_category.description: Number of templates contributed by this paper to each DIS category.

evidence_count.description: Evidence metadata for this paper record.

count.description: Number of source entries (templates) from this paper.

source.description: Source identifier. For private builds: pdf_id. For public output: 'abstracted'.

confidence.description: Confidence level: high (≥30 templates), medium (10-29), low (<10), pending (not computed).

quality_distribution.description: Distribution of quality scores across templates from this paper.

Q2.description: Count of templates with quality_score = 2 (high quality).

Q0.description: Count of templates with quality_score = 0 (low/needs revision).

source.description: Origin institution or collection identifier (e.g., 'MSU', 'SPbU'). For public output: 'abstracted'.

subject.description: Detailed subject area (optional, more granular than discipline).

AREF_categories_present.description: Russian academic attestation (AREF) categories found in this paper. Optional.
